max_fee_cap.meaning: DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP, the maximum dynamic fee cap, set to 500000 (50%)

dynamic_fee.meaning: dynamically calculated swap fee value produced by the dynamic fee module, compared against MAX_FEE_CAP

fee_accepted_by_get_swap_fee.meaning: CLFactory.getSwapFee() accepts (does not reject) the dynamically calculated fee

anti_mev_cap_unusable.meaning: the 50% anti-MEV protection cap becomes unusable
anti_mev_cap_unusable.checkpoint: after CLFactory.getSwapFee() rejects the dynamically calculated fee

assumptions: dynamic_fee is the dynamically calculated fee value that CLFactory.getSwapFee() evaluates against MAX_FEE_CAP
limitations: Report does not state a concrete dynamic fee value above the rejection threshold; dynamic_fee remains symbolic.
The exact rejection threshold used by CLFactory.getSwapFee() relative to MAX_FEE_CAP is not numerically specified beyond the intent that fees up to MAX_FEE_CAP should be accepted.
